description: The canonical Dabbler sample project. One source of truth for three consumers: the `Dabbler: Try a sample project` command, docs/tutorials/hello-world.md (bound in Set 107 Session 2, which authors that tutorial), and the Layer-2 smoke test. Files under files/ are rendered verbatim into the target folder; a `dot-` filename prefix renders as a leading dot. The tests are stdlib unittest on purpose -- the sample must need no install beyond dabbler-ai-router itself. Every CONTRACT field here is read by a test, because a claimed-but-unenforced contract is worse than no contract; this `description` is the sole exception and is prose for humans, carrying no contract.
